```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(uwot)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------
freq_rds <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/motif_analysis_no_annot/endmotif_4bp_freq_per_sample_ATGC_only.rds"

meta_single_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv"

sig_motif_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_motif_results_single_site_top3/ATGC_only/res_4bp_kw_top_sites_ATGC.csv"

outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/figures_multivariate"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

top_sites <- c("brain", "bone", "liver")
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Load data
# -----------------------------
df_freq <- readRDS(freq_rds)

meta_single <- read_csv(meta_single_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
  ) %>%
  filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)

kw_res <- read_csv(sig_motif_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Select top 4 significant motifs (you can tighten p < 0.05 if needed)
sig_motifs <- kw_res %>%
  arrange(desc(effsize)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 4) %>%
  pull(end_motif)

cat("Using motifs:\n")
print(sig_motifs)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Build wide matrix
# -----------------------------
df_wide <- df_freq %>%
  filter(end_motif %in% sig_motifs) %>%
  inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
  select(id, metastatic_sites, end_motif, freq.corrected) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = end_motif,
    values_from = freq.corrected
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

# Feature matrix
X <- df_wide %>%
  select(all_of(sig_motifs)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Scale (critical)
X_scaled <- scale(X)

meta <- df_wide %>%
  select(id, metastatic_sites) %>%
  mutate(metastatic_sites = factor(metastatic_sites, levels = top_sites))
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# PCA
# -----------------------------
pca <- prcomp(X_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

pca_df <- as_tibble(pca$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  bind_cols(meta)

var_exp <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df,
                aes(PC1, PC2, color = metastatic_sites)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    brain = "#4DBBD5",
    bone  = "#E64B35",
    liver = "#00A087"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of significant 4-mer end motifs",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "PC1: ", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%, ",
      "PC2: ", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%"
    ),
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "PCA_4mer_significant.png"),
       p_pca, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# UMAP
# -----------------------------
set.seed(123)

umap_emb <- umap(
  X_scaled,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.3,
  metric = "euclidean"
)

umap_df <- as_tibble(umap_emb) %>%
  setNames(c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")) %>%
  bind_cols(meta)

p_umap <- ggplot(umap_df,
                 aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = metastatic_sites)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    brain = "#4DBBD5",
    bone  = "#E64B35",
    liver = "#00A087"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP of significant 4-mer end motifs",
    subtitle = "Non-linear embedding of GC-corrected motif frequencies"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "UMAP_4mer_significant.png"),
       p_umap, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

cat("Saved PCA and UMAP to:\n", outdir, "\n")

```
```{r}
library(Rtsne)
# -----------------------------
# t-SNE
# -----------------------------
set.seed(123)

# t-SNE perplexity must be < (n_samples - 1)/3
n_samp <- nrow(X_scaled)
perp <- min(30, floor((n_samp - 1) / 3))
perp <- max(perp, 5)   # keep reasonable minimum

tsne_out <- Rtsne(
  X_scaled,
  dims = 2,
  perplexity = perp,
  pca = FALSE,         # we already scaled; skip internal PCA
  check_duplicates = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

tsne_df <- as_tibble(tsne_out$Y) %>%
  setNames(c("tSNE1", "tSNE2")) %>%
  bind_cols(meta)

p_tsne <- ggplot(tsne_df, aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, color = metastatic_sites)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    brain = "#4DBBD5",
    bone  = "#E64B35",
    liver = "#00A087"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "t-SNE of significant 4-mer end motifs",
    subtitle = paste0("Perplexity = ", perp, " (GC-corrected motif frequencies)")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

print(p_tsne)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "tSNE_4mer_significant.png"),
       p_tsne, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "tSNE_4mer_significant.pdf"),
       p_tsne, width = 6, height = 5)

```
